name: qualification-g63
why: G6.3 in one instance. item:current-mand is an authoritative elimination and binds, so room is reserved for it and it is carried at a representation whose OWN provenance is current. item:stale-mand is marked Mandatory but every representation it has is stale, so it never binds, never forces an overflow and is simply not affordable here - it keeps its qualification instead of being promoted into an active constraint.
